declared: filter official ChatGPT exports by conversation id
normalize selected chat messages into local transcript inbox
preserve source hash and source locator
emit source-only records for later reviewed promotion
route geopolitical forecast material through evidence-boundary classification
unsupported: automatic factual verification of geopolitical claims

capabilities.probe: Run tools/Import-AthenaChatExport.ps1 with -NoWrite against a scoped source export and confirm coverage reports one selected conversation.

inputs: operator-provided official ChatGPT export JSON or ZIP
explicit conversation id or title scope
outputs: candidate promotion records in continuity/chat-repository-sync/promotion-ledger.jsonl after review

confirmation_required: promoting source material into canonical memory
publishing or pushing raw transcript material

state_transfer.dock: Load AI-PORTAL.md, sync policy, chat import script, source scope, and the latest user request before import.
state_transfer.undock: Report bundle id, coverage, truncation or attachment gaps, files written, validation result, and promotion status.
state_transfer.handoff: Name the source export hash, selected conversation id, evidence boundary policy, accepted promotions, contradictions, and remaining unknowns.

operation.rate_limit: One import per source hash unless -Force is explicitly selected.

failure.detect: Import script exception, zero selected conversations, JSON parse failure, schema mismatch, or repository validation failure.
failure.contain: Leave raw source in ignored transcript inbox and do not promote into canonical memory.
failure.rollback: Remove the generated import bundle only after confirming the bundle path is under continuity/transcript-inbox/imports/.
failure.emergency_stop: Stop import and report the source path, bundle path if created, and failing validation step.

provenance.secret_policy: Do not copy account-wide exports, credentials, private unrelated chats, or raw transcript bundles into tracked files or publication targets.
